newsitem.title: UK: Dorling shares drop on profits warning.
newsitem.headline: Dorling shares drop on profits warning.

text.p: Shares in Dorling Kindersley Holdings Plc tumbled almost 14 percent on Tuesday after the encyclopedia and CD-ROM publisher warned that the strength of sterling would squeeze its profits in the current year.
Shares in the company were down 71p at 447-1/2 by 1215 GMT in volume of 1.1 million shares.

Dorling Kindersley chairman and chief executive Peter Kindersley said 1997 turnover could be cut by five million stg and pre-tax profit by 1.6 million if sterling remained close to its current level of around $1.69.
The company makes some 40 percent of its sales in the U.S.
